form201.incidentName: FICTIONAL EXERCISE - Maple Ridge missing adult with dementia
form201.situationSummary: FICTIONAL ILLUSTRATION ONLY; not an operational plan. Ellis Linden, fictional 74-year-old adult with dementia, wandered from a residence at Residence / IPP, 1 Trail Lane, fictional Maple Ridge, MA; last seen there at 0500 July 18. Staging: Community park pavilion staging, 20 Park Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (0.8 km west of IPP). Command staff: ICP, county community center, 50 Civic Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (1.5 km west of IPP). Wearing a blue shirt and tan trousers; may not respond to calls. Returned three-person visual tracker task T1 (0700-0800), debriefed at 0810, reported a definitely human sign line north from IPP, with no clear prints or sole pattern; potential clue flagged on Ops instruction, subject association unverified and follow-up not yet undertaken at the 0815 snapshot. Summer forecast 27-31 C, humid, light wind; shaded woodland, uneven trails, creek edges and ticks. No aircraft. Koster hub/spokes/rim: protect the residence/last-known-point hub; stage away from the IPP; search travel spokes promptly; observe likely rim exits, then search bounded areas and familiar attractors. G1 splits into four-person G1-A/G1-B on routes A/B; four-person G2-A takes route C, all 0715-1000. Returned trackers MR-P13/MR-P14/MR-P15 await K3 at staging; one G2 member and three released K3 support remain reserve until the eight-person G2 grid reassembles at 1030. G1 reassembles eight for attractors then grid. All names, agencies, geography, contacts, capabilities and approvals are invented.

objectives: Mitigate all hazards to responders and the general public to an acceptable level, with particular attention to heat stress and tick exposure, throughout the entire duration of the incident.
By 1000, complete hasty searches of the three most likely travel corridors from IPP to containment boundary at least once.
By 0800, establish containment of both likely egress points and maintain it through 1900.
By 1700, search the high-probability inner 25% zone to a coverage target of approximately 1.
By 1200, search all three familiar attractors and associated hazard points within 1 km of IPP.

form202.situationalAwareness: 0815 July 18, 2026 exercise snapshot. Fictional Ellis Linden, 74-year-old adult with dementia, last seen 0500 July 18 at Residence / IPP, 1 Trail Lane, fictional Maple Ridge, MA. Wearing a blue shirt and tan trousers; may hide or not answer. T1's three visual trackers returned at 0800 after 0700-0800 work around IPP, debriefed at 0810: a definitely human sign line led north, with no clear prints or sole pattern. This potential clue was flagged on Ops instruction; subject association remains unverified and follow-up has not yet been undertaken. Forecast 27-31 C, humid, light wind; shaded woodland, uneven trails and creek edges. Staging: Community park pavilion staging, 20 Park Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (0.8 km west of IPP). Separate command post: ICP, county community center, 50 Civic Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (1.5 km west of IPP). Base (supply and rehab) colocated with Community park pavilion staging, 20 Park Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (0.8 km west of IPP) provides water resupply, an unstaffed human aid-supply cache and heat rehab coordination. All teams report directly to Ops; no branches, divisions or groups. 36 human field searchers INCLUDE four handlers. Six IMT at ICP, county community center, 50 Civic Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (1.5 km west of IPP); IC Avery Wren is Sheriff of Fictional Pine County Sheriff's Office. No aircraft. Seven teams active at 0815; returned trackers are available at staging for K3 at 1030. Ops must reassess span before later launches and stagger/pause work if direct supervision becomes unsafe; eight teams is not assumed manageable. Koster hub/spokes/rim guides prioritization, not a guarantee of containment. No negative search guarantees absence. Summer heat and ticks require continuous reassessment.

entries.mitigations: Use repellent per label, long trousers and buddy tick checks at 1000 and ; promptly remove attached ticks with proper tool and report exposures to MEDL.
Maintain buddy contact, deliberate footing and suitable boots; avoid unstable banks and water entry. Stop and report unsafe crossings; use an alternate route authorized by Ops.

entries.hazardsRisks: Summer heat / dehydration / canine heat stress
entries.mitigations: Water resupply at Base (supply and rehab) colocated with Community park pavilion staging, 20 Park Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (0.8 km west of IPP) by 0900; hourly hydration/electrolyte checks for all field teams. Mandatory heat rehab with shaded rest and heat-illness checks from 1300 at Base, plus rest as needed; Ops staggers search-team returns to Base. Containment posts remain staffed: observation buddies alternate 1300-1320/1320-1340 in adjacent shade, retaining buddy contact and uninterrupted observation; repeat at least hourly. Ops must arrange qualified relief before either post pair travels to Base; never send both observers away without relief. Canine 20-minute work/cooling cycles; handlers monitor dogs continuously. Stop work for heat illness signs; notify MEDL, cool safely and request assistance.

form204.specialInstructions: FICTIONAL EXERCISE ONLY. Calm approach to vulnerable adult; do not chase. Preserve clues, report location immediately, avoid contaminating scent articles. T1 reported a definitely human sign line north of IPP, with no clear prints or sole pattern; Ops instructed trackers to flag the potential clue and return. Subject association unverified; follow-up not yet undertaken at 0815. Preserve the flagged location pending Ops direction. Check in every 30 minutes. Seven teams initially active; Ops reassesses span before later launches and staggers/pauses work rather than assuming eight active teams manageable. No simultaneous tasks for any member.

openActionItems.item: First tick check: ALL teams complete and report buddy tick checks by 1000; Safety verifies completion; MEDL tracks exposures.

Hourly hydration/electrolyte checks for all field teams; replenish drinking water at Base (supply and rehab) colocated with Community park pavilion staging, 20 Park Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (0.8 km west of IPP) by 0900 and arrange field/canine water delivery requests through simulated support service. Planning and Safety verify every team.

MANDATORY heat rehab with shaded rest and heat-illness checks from 1300 at Base (supply and rehab) colocated with Community park pavilion staging, 20 Park Road, fictional Maple Ridge, MA (0.8 km west of IPP); Ops staggers search-team returns, coordinated by Safety/MEDL at ICP. Observation buddies alternate rest 1300-1320/1320-1340 in adjacent shade with continuous observation and buddy contact; Ops arranges qualified relief before post pairs travel to Base. Never leave a containment post unstaffed for rehab.

End-shift : Safety begins tick/hydration checks at 1830 and verifies completion before release; account for all 42 people and four canines, complete task debriefs, equipment return and safe-travel checks. Maintain paired containment posts through 1900; verify continuing containment/relief needs with Ops before releasing anyone.
